name: @red-cup-engineering/parlor-kernel
description: The shared kernel for the parlor shelf's dice, board-race, and slot games: seeded dice rolls with exact PMFs (dice), a pure turn/round reducer over intents (turns), a board-as-directed-graph with chute/ladder jump edges (board), Pig/Farkle/Yacht scoring folds (tally), computed bust/expectation/RTP odds (odds), slot reels as data with seeded spins (reels), multi-reel/multi-payline grid evaluation with wilds, scatters, and exact multi-line RTP by full-grid enumeration (paylines — added 2026-08-29 for Cowrie Casino's 5x3 video slot, additive to reels/odds), the reversible/priced/terminal spend classifier (disclosure). One small kernel, games as data plus a thin face.

scripts.check: for f in src/*.mjs src/fixtures/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
